purpose: Test whether previously demonstrated low-cap demand followed by deep drawdown can produce prospectively identifiable, sellable secondary-expansion alpha when recovery is confirmed by microstructure, liquidity survival, wallet re-entry and pre-social timing.
principle: The social-post thresholds are discovery inspiration, not canonical alpha rules. Phoenix measures relative lifecycle recovery and state transitions rather than relying on one fixed market-cap filter.

required: material verified drawdown from a reproducible prior peak
sellability pass or deterministic sell simulation
eligibility.adaptive_rule: Absolute seed thresholds must be compared with chain, venue, age and liquidity cohorts before any promotion. Fixed thresholds may not become canonical merely because historical winners fit them.

feature_families.M: market microstructure recovery: unique buyer velocity, transaction velocity, buy/sell balance, volume reacceleration, declining sell pressure
feature_families.L: liquidity survival: current/peak liquidity retention, liquidity trend through drawdown and retest, executable depth
feature_families.W: wallet evidence: same-token skilled-wallet re-entry, independent quality-wallet convergence, distribution behavior, economic-entity independence
feature_families.S: social timing: exact-CA social re-propagation, lead time from on-chain wakeup, crowd saturation and control-root independence
feature_families.H: holder structure: holder breadth, concentration change, whale distribution/accumulation where reproducible
feature_families.P: price structure: bottom compression, first reclaim, controlled pullback, retest integrity; price alone can never qualify

state_machine.wakeup_minimum: At least two independent recovery families, one of which must be M or L. Price-only or volume-only wakeups are forbidden.
state_machine.pre_reclaim_convergence: At least three independent families, with M required and either L or W required; broad social saturation must still be below the configured ceiling.
state_machine.reclaim: Price structure confirms first meaningful reclaim while sellability and liquidity remain valid.
state_machine.retest_pending: After reclaim, the engine must observe a pullback/retest before a gamble candidate can exist.
state_machine.retest_passed: During pullback, liquidity deterioration remains bounded, sellability remains valid, quality-wallet thesis does not materially reverse, and sell pressure does not reaccelerate beyond configured tolerance.
state_machine.gamble_candidate: Research-only state. Requires RETEST_PASSED plus at least three independent signal families including M and at least one of W/L. No automatic trade or position-size authority.

wallet_alpha.highest_value_signal: same-token RE_ENTRY by a wallet with prospectively demonstrated skill on that token, before broad social re-propagation
wallet_alpha.stronger_signal: two or more economically independent quality wallets re-enter the same exact CA before broad social re-propagation

pullback_retest.purpose: Use the first pullback as a prospective stress test rather than chasing the initial recovery candle.
pass_evidence: liquidity survives within configured deterioration tolerance
quality wallets do not materially distribute
buyer breadth remains above dormant baseline
price does not invalidate the recovered structure

prospective_arms.CONTROL: Matched crashed survivors satisfying broad eligibility but without recovery trigger.
prospective_arms.R: price reclaim alone; measurement control only and never sufficient for user alert.
prospective_arms.MWL: microstructure plus wallet plus liquidity survival.
prospective_arms.MWLS: microstructure plus wallet plus liquidity plus pre-social timing.

adaptive_evolution.training_population: prospectively observed Phoenix-eligible crashed survivors only
